title: Phone Chips Reached 19 Billion Transistors—Then Doubling Slowed
hook: Phone chips reached 19 billion transistors, but progress is slowing.
closing: Future phones can improve, but each transistor leap now takes longer.
question: Does your phone feel faster?

segments.say: A phone chip reached 19 billion transistors. Tiny switches now pack enormous computing power.
Chip transistor doubling now takes about 3 years. The old pace is slipping.
Modern chip manufacturing reached 2 nanometers. Shrinking further becomes harder as components approach physical limits.
